description: README collected for a listing (R2). Only when get_listing carries readme_api; 404 when none was stored. The text lives in R2 (`mural-coleta`). This call does not write and does not fetch GitHub. Same visibility as the listing page. Call it only when the listing page carries `readme_api`: a page without it has no README collected, and this route answers 404.
